title: Trading “bot”
author: Zh00_dev
selftext:
Hi! I built an autonomous stock research and portfolio management system focused on S&P 500 stocks, combining quantitative economic theory with LLMs.  
If anyone would like to try it out or share their feedback, here’s the repository:

https://github.com/cve-zh00/alphalab

**P.S.** Over the course of one month, it delivered a 5.8% return (nearly 10 percentage points above the S&P 500).  
**P.P.S.** You can test it using an Alpaca paper trading account. It’s free and easy to set up.

comments.author: investigatormaker
comments.body:
Alpaca paper trading lets people test this without risking money, but one month's return doesn't establish whether the strategy holds up. I'd include a reproducible paper-trading run with dates, starting allocation, benchmark, turnover and maximum drawdown, plus logs showing what information each LLM decision used. Keep backtests separate from paper results so reviewers can tell which evidence they're judging.
